data.Q: Why does Jotham live in Beer?
data.wrong_answer: Because Abimelek had governed Israel three years.

data.Q: After Abimelek rules Israel three years, who causes the hostility?
For what purpose does God cause the hostility?
data.A: To pay back the killing of Jerub-Baal’s seventy sons against Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem.
data.wrong_answer: So the citizens act treacherously against Abimelek.

data.Q: On whom should the payback for the killings fall?
data.A: Abimelek and the citizens of Shechem.

data.Q: Whom did the citizens of Shechem help in the murders?
Whom do the citizens oppose when they set ambushes?
